caseNameFull: John F. Doyle and John F. Doyle, Jr., Individually and as Copartners, Trading as John F. Doyle & Son v. George J. Schmidheiser, Trustee, etc.
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. John P. Connolly for the appellants. Mr. Otto Wolff, Jr., for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Holden v. Stratton, 191 U. S. 115; Duryea Power Co. v. Sternbergh, 218 U. S. 299; Pennsylvania v. York Silk Manufacturing Co., 232 U. S. 718.
